checks: Connection feedback stays inside the button: Testing, Success, Failed and Slow after 3 seconds; feedback resets after 5 seconds and raw replies never appear.
Changing connection settings invalidates an in-flight probe; dark mode keeps readable state icons and failed responses expose only safe diagnostics.
Result opened near the screen bottom keeps the same x/y when delayed suggestions arrive; oversized results scroll inside a bounded window.
scope: Isolated desktop profile and local HTTP fixtures. Bottom-of-screen anchoring is driven through development-only selection hooks; packaged mode uses the normal command trial.
